B8.1.1.1.2 Compare and contrast the processes involved in performing puberty rites in his/her culture to other cultures of Ghana.

1.standard: B8.1.1.1 Demonstrate understanding of how puberty rites are performed in his/her linguistic community, its significance and compare with other cultures of Ghana.
indicators: B8.1.1.1.3 Discuss the changes that has occurred in puberty rites performance over time.

1.standard: B8.2.5.1 Demonstrate knowledge of presentational skills in listening, following daily conversation, speaking clearly and explaining ideas.
indicators: B8.2.5.1.1 Develop and modify his/her language in narrating some selected daily activities.

1.standard: B8.3.1.1 Understand the main ideas and supporting points in texts
indicators: B8.3.1.1.1 Understand main ideas and supporting points in a range of extended texts on familiar and unfamiliar topics.
B8.3.1.1.2 Summarize long passages read.

1.standard: B8.3.2.1 Demonstrate knowledge of translating words, phrases and sentences
indicators: B8.3.2.1.1 Establish the meaning of words, phrases and sentences in their various languages.

1.standard: B8.4.1.1 Demonstrate knowledge and understanding of nouns, pronouns and adjectives.
indicators: B8.4.1.1.1 Classify nouns under various types (abstract, concrete, countable and uncountable nouns).

1.standard: B8.4.2.1 Demonstrate knowledge and understanding of verbs, adverb, conjunctions
indicators: B8.4.1.1.2 Determine the types of pronouns in his/her language.
B8.4.1.1.3 Determine and categorise adjectives under size, colour, shape, quantity, etc in his/her language.
B8.4.2.1.1 Recognise and use the tense and aspectual (habitual, progressive, future) forms of verbs in sentences.
B8.4.2.1.2 Identify and use adverbs appropriately in sentences.
B8.4.2.1.3 Identify and use an increasing range of conjunctions appropriately and correctly in a given text.

1.standard: B8.5.1.1 Demonstrate knowledge and understanding of the ability to write meaningful compositions on the various text types (persuasive/argumentative writing, informative/academic/expository and letter writing).
indicators: B8.5.1.1.1 Develop coherent essay using the features of given text types.

1.standard: B8.6.1.1 Demonstrate knowledge and understanding of proverbs and idioms.
indicators: B8.6.1.1.1 Discuss the features of proverbs and idioms.

1.standard: B8.6.1.2 Demonstrate knowledge and understanding on the writer's use of language in a prose, poetry and drama texts.
indicators: B8.6.1.2.1 Discuss how writers use language to create effect in prose, poetry and drama.

indicators: B9.1.1.1.3 Compare and contrast the traditional marriage rites to the contemporary marriage rites and dramatise.

1.standard: B9.2.1.1: Demonstrate use of appropriate language orally in specific situations
indicators: B9.2.1.1.1. Use appropriate register in everyday communication (informal and formal) with diverse partners on grade-level topics/texts/issue.
B9.2.1.1.2. Ask questions that link the ideas of several speakers and respond to others' questions in a discussion.
B9.2.1.1.3. Use appropriate language orally to discuss grade-level national issues fluently.
B9.2.1.1.4. Express opinions and advice on a range of everyday issues and situations clearly.
B9.2.1.1.5. Demonstrate appropriate turn taking and use techniques for effective argument (debate).

1.standard: B9.3.1.1 Read longer passages silently, identify main ideas, answer questions and summarise the passage
indicators: B9.3.1.1.1 Locate the main and subsidiary points in a range of texts and rewrite logically with accuracy in his/her own words.
B9.3.1.1.2 Summarise passages read in given number of sentences.

1.standard: B9.3.2.1 Demonstrate knowledge of translating texts from source language to the target language.
indicators: B9.3.2.1.1 Decode the meaning of texts and translate from source to target language.

1.standard: B9.4.1.1 Demonstrate knowledge of the use of singular and plural nouns in sentences and passages. / B9.4.1.2 Demonstrate knowledge of how adjectives are combined in a sentence.
indicators: B9.4.1.1.1 Discuss nouns under singular and plural.
B9.4.1.2.1 Discuss how adjectives follow each other in a sentence.

1.standard: B9.4.2.1 Exhibit knowledge and understanding of the use of auxiliary verbs. / B9.4.2.2 Demonstrate knowledge of how adverbs are combined in a sentence.
indicators: B9.4.2.1.1 Discuss auxiliary verbs in sentences.
B9.4.2.1.3 Discuss how adverbs follow each other in a sentence.

1.standard: B9.5.1.1 Demonstrate knowledge and understanding of the features of the various text types discussed and use the knowledge to write a coherent essay on the text types.
indicators: B9.5.1.1.1 Plan and structure a range of extended texts using paragraphs to show progression from one idea to the next and linking paragraphs using cohesive language.

1.standard: B9.6.1.1 Demonstrate an understanding of drum language, appellations and war songs. / B9.6.1.2 Demonstrate knowledge and understanding on the writer's use of language in a prose, poetry and drama texts.
indicators: B9.6.1.1.1 Explore drum language/appellations and war songs respectively.
B9.6.1.2.1 Discuss how writers use language to create effect in an increasing range of prose, poetry and drama.
